title: Jonah and the Vow
author: Sable Coldharbour
blurb: Kestrel Montrose, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
